title: The Midnight Bakery Fire
charge: Arson with intent to defraud an insurer
summary: At about 2 AM on March 14, Marsh & Daughters Bakery burned down. Owner Leo Marsh had taken out a large fire insurance policy two months earlier. The prosecution claims he set the fire himself to collect the payout.

witnesses.name: Inspector Ruth Kale
witnesses.personality: Confident, brisk, dislikes being questioned, wrote her report in a hurry because of a backlog.

testimony.text: The fire started at about 2:10 AM in the storage room.
We found a gasoline can near the back door.
There was no sign of any electrical fault.

hiddenFacts.text: She never examined the oven wall; she assumed the storage room was the origin because of the gasoline can.
The wiring behind oven B was too badly burned to test, so 'no fault' really means 'not checked'.

witnesses.name: Dana Pike
witnesses.personality: Friendly but nervous, over-explains, gets defensive about paperwork.

testimony.text: I serviced the ovens on March 3rd, eleven days before the fire.
Everything was in perfect working order.
I never went back to the bakery after that visit.

hiddenFacts.text: Pike skipped the March service to save time and back-dated the invoice.
Pike returned on March 13 to run a generator for a quick repair and left the gasoline can behind.

witnesses.name: Sam Ortiz
witnesses.personality: Chatty, sure of himself, a bit of a gossip, refuses to wear his glasses.

testimony.text: I saw Leo's car parked at the bakery at 2 AM.
The lights were on inside the bakery.
I heard a loud bang just before the smoke started.

hiddenFacts.text: He was not wearing his glasses; the car was a similar grey hatchback belonging to a delivery driver.

evidence.name: Insurance policy
evidence.description: Fire insurance policy for the bakery, signed January 10. Payout: 400,000.

evidence.name: Gasoline can receipt
evidence.description: Hardware store receipt for the gasoline can found at the scene, dated March 12, billed to 'Pike Electrical'.

evidence.name: Oven maintenance log
evidence.description: The bakery's maintenance log. Last service entry: January 12. No entry for March.

evidence.name: Traffic camera still
evidence.description: Highway camera photo of Leo Marsh's licence plate, 20 km from the bakery, at 2:05 AM on March 14.

evidence.name: Burn pattern photo
evidence.description: Close-up of the V-shaped burn pattern; its point is at the wall outlet behind oven B, not in the storage room.
